Water Polo: Georgia beats Turkey and takes stride towards World Cup #1TVSPORT
14:27, 10.04.2026
 
The Georgian national water polo team faced Turkey in the round of 16 of the World Cup qualifiers and won 19–12. It was a thoroughly deserved act of revenge for their defeat by the same side in the group stage.

The victory sends Georgia through to the quarter-finals, where their opponents will be determined in due course, the winner of the Canada–Ukraine tie. To secure a place at the World Cup, Georgia must win two more matches: the quarter-final and the semi-final, with berths at the tournament awarded to both finalists.

The 2026 Water Polo World Cup takes place in Australia from July 22 to 26.
